WITH invoice_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
    AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
), overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio
  FROM invoice_metrics
)
SELECT
  AVG(im.avg_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
  AVG(im.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
  AVG(im.avg_ratio - oa.overall_avg_ratio) AS average_excess_ratio
FROM invoice_metrics im
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE im.avg_ratio > oa.overall_avg_ratio;
